## IRenderMediaGroupKindParams type

`IRenderMediaGroupParams` for one group kind — the per-kind group wrappers (`renderPhotoGroup`<!-- -->, `renderVideoGroup`<!-- -->, …) accept this shape and supply `type`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IRenderMediaGroupKindParams = Omit<IGroupR1, `type`> | Omit<IGroupR2, `type`>;
```

## Remarks

`Omit` is applied per union member — applied to the union it would collapse the routes together.
